summary.text: Tim Coffin is an independent candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 27, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Coffin said he has close to four decades of experience in municipal finance.

paragraphs.text: Tim Coffin's career experience, according to Ballotpedia, includes working in finance.
In his 2026 survey he described close to four decades in municipal finance, working with public officials and investors on projects such as schools, roads and bridges, and clean water.
Coffin described his campaign as "Common Ground - Common Sense" and said he would be accountable to the district rather than to a party.
Coffin listed government accountability and transparency, investing in public education, and climate resiliency and adaptation as policy areas he is passionate about.
